field: -
description:
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Tokyo for our hybrid working model.
[under: What you do at MongoDB] - Design and Architect: Own the end-to-end technical strategy for complex opportunities, designing scalable and performant applications, systems, and infrastructure leveraging MongoDB. Lead architecture reviews, evaluate trade-offs, and reduce technical risk across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.
[under: What you will learn] - Modern Application Architectures: Design cloud-native, distributed, highly available, secure, and observable systems across hyperscaler, on-premises, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments.
[under: About MongoDB] With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
